mentions.name: RxJS Vite DevTools Plugin
mentions.description: This Vite plugin provides React DevTools-style visual debugging for RxJS. It parses and models the HMR process, stores the data as flatly as possible using a relation-first design, and aims to work for React developers first with possible Angular support later.
mentions.problem: RxJS lacks devtools-caliber tooling, making it hard to recommend without a visual helper for debugging streams.
mentions.audience: React and Angular developers using RxJS, including maintenance of existing codebases
mentions.source_excerpt: RxJS vite plugin that operates in much the same way as react devtools and vite plugin, because I love rxjs but I cannot recommend it without that same calibur of tooling.

evidence.value: RxJS vite plugin that operates in much the same way as react devtools and vite plugin, because I love rxjs but I cannot recommend it without that same calibur of tooling.
